answer: A per-identity stake bond, slashed retroactively on proven collusion, is the mechanism. Each new identity must lock real collateral before it can attest, so a farm of a thousand puppets needs a thousand simultaneous locks of idle capital; cost rises with fake identities. When graders catch coordinated voting the cluster is slashed together, costing the attacker the whole pool, not one account. Defeating that needs forged histories and unique footprints, like finding one lotus in a dry basin, which burns real effort long after the first ocean of keys, and no forge of cheap wallets replaces it.
